# Blind test author fixtures

`installation-fee.yaml` is a reduced module in the shape of the landed Arizona
module `us-az/policies/des/faa5/na-utility-expenses-and-allowances/block-13.yaml`
(rulespec-us main): one Judgment rule over implicit boolean facts, with a proof
block. `installation-fee.source.txt` holds the sentences that module quotes
from its corpus unit; it is a reduced stand-in for the corpus row, not the
release-bound body. Tests write both into a temporary `rulespec-us/us-az/`
checkout.
